brief.zh: 从元件盒拖出按钮、电阻和 LED，自己选孔插好，用跳线接出一盏按钮灯。先猜按下和松开时灯会怎样，再通电试一试。
brief.en: Drag the button, resistor and LED out of the parts box and plug them into holes you choose. Add jumpers to build a button light. Predict what happens when you press and release it, then power up to test.

concept.zh: 用跳线连接同编号的导电孔组
concept.en: Build a circuit using jumpers and numbered contact strips

hints.zh: 断电后选万用表的通断档，把两支表笔放到同一编号的两个孔，再换到别的编号。接好跳线后，再量一次原来的两个孔。
hints.en: With the power off, select continuity and touch the probes to two holes on the same numbered strip. Try different strips, then add a jumper and check those holes again.

hints.zh: 同一编号的五个孔下面是一片金属。想接到元件的一只脚，可以把跳线插进同一编号的另一个空孔。
hints.en: One metal strip joins all five holes with the same number. To connect a jumper to a leg, plug it into another free hole on the same strip.

hints.zh: 保持跳线原样，把 LED 的一只脚移到不同编号，或者翻转 LED。再预测一次，看看哪一种摆法能让电流通过。
hints.en: Leave the jumpers in place. Move an LED leg to another numbered strip or flip the LED. Predict again and see which arrangement lets current through.

hints.zh: 从 5V 用手指顺着你的线路走一圈。闭合开关时，电流要经过电阻，从 LED 的 A 端进入、K 端出来，再回到 GND。
hints.en: Trace your wiring from 5V with your finger. With the switch closed, current must pass through the resistor, enter LED pin A, leave pin K and return to GND.
